title: 第八章 金血玄参
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
因为九劫九重天神功，有一个最大的特点。那就是只知道口诀，没有任何用处，必须得到相应的剑身，在剑身上，附着有一股怪异的力量，吸纳了那股力量之后，才能按照口诀修炼九劫九重天神功，进境也会很快！
而且每一截剑身上附着的力量都不相同！
若是没有得到九劫剑身，就贸然练习的话，恐怕在一时三刻之内，就会烈焰焚心而死！
二来，楚阳现在的身体状态，也还没有达到修炼九重天神功的条件。唯有在武士之后，浑身经脉畅通，气血逐渐旺盛，脱离小周天，进入大周天循环，才能修炼九劫九重天！
东方一亮，太阳猛地跳出了地平线，楚阳最后深深的吸了一口气，收功而起，静静的站立一会，只觉得全身都是暖洋洋的，说不出的惬意……
他就这么站着，眯着眼睛看着聚云峰的方向，那里，九劫剑第一截，就在那地基之下静静的埋藏着。
必须要尽快得到！
楚阳眼中闪出锋锐的光芒。他看了好一会，才收回目光。
谨慎的看看四周，确认没有别人，然后他的身形展动，从陡峭的石壁上，慢慢的滑落了下去。一双眼睛，谨慎地注视着上下左右，因为，若是石千山说的没错的话，那么，就在这片石壁上，就生长着那金血玄参！
金血玄参，并不算是顶级灵药。但就算是在上三天，也是有价无市的东西。所有的大家族，都需要这种灵药来为自己家族的后辈子孙打基础！
大家族的子孙，甚至有很多是一出生就喂以金血玄参！趁着母体先天之气未散，有绝顶高手辅助婴儿行功化开药力，则能够生生的造就一位惊天动地的武学奇才！
若是这位奇才长大能够刻苦努力的话，那将来的成就，绝对的不可想象！而所有的成绩，有一大部分的功劳，是来自幼年时这一株金血玄参！
世家子弟，之所以一个个修炼速度绝快，灵药堆积，乃是最重要的原因！
这个世上，永远不缺少天才！天才，也的确比平常人多了太多成功的机会！但有一点同样不可否认：这个世上夭折或者慢慢归于平淡的天才，永远是成功的天才的无数倍！
我不是天才，但我却要将自己改造成比天才更天才的天才！我要让天才在我面前，什么都不是！
楚阳慢慢地往下滑，他的整个身体附在滑溜溜的崖壁上，却是进退自如，如同一只大壁虎，稳稳的在笔直如削的悬崖上移动。
这是前世他杀了一个武尊之后，从那人身上搜出来的一门功法，唤作“空天神游术”。感觉有用，就练了练。
现在用起来，虽然现在的这具身体从未修炼过，但也能勉强运用出来……
下面簌簌的声音响起，一股腥风突然传来。
楚阳眉头一皱，目光一闪，撑在石壁上的右手一用力，整个身子无声无息的在石壁上横移七尺！刷的一声，一条色彩斑斓的毒蛇正好从他身边掠过！

若是他刚才没有横移，这条毒蛇大张的口便正好咬在他腿上！
楚阳眼中闪出喜色，这里果然有金血玄参！而且还是百年之上的！
这条蛇，浑身七彩鳞片，手臂粗细，头上一个肉冠。正是七彩金冠蛇。
野生的金血玄参，百年之上的都会有一条七彩金冠蛇守护。所以楚阳一见这条蛇，顿时就断定了金血玄参之事是真的。
这种蛇鳞甲坚硬，刀剑难伤，身有奇毒。平常蛇类的弱点七寸，在这条蛇身上根本不是弱点。
它的致命之处，便是头顶上那个肉冠！
百年以上的金血玄参，便会发散出一种淡淡的气味，而这种气味，对七彩金冠蛇有着致命的吸引力。这种气味，能够让七彩金冠蛇在蜕皮进阶的时候，没有丝毫痛苦！
对七彩金冠蛇来说，金血玄参本身没什么用处。但这股气味，却是它梦寐以求的东西。
沙沙声起，七彩金冠蛇迅速的掉转头，向着楚阳冲了过来，尾巴打在石壁上，发出啪的一声，竟然凌空飞起，向楚阳噬来。
楚阳眼神凝聚成了针尖一般，一动不动。只等蛇距离自己还有一尺之时，才猛地一闪身子，往右一闪，往上一蹿，身子扭成诡异的弓形，七彩金冠蛇与他擦身而过，就在这瞬间，楚阳两根手指并起如剑，全身功力凝聚在手指，狠狠地戳在了七彩金冠蛇头顶那肉冠之上！

content_en:
Because the Nine Tribulations and Nine Levels Divine Art has one of the biggest characteristics. That is to only know the formula, which is of no use. You must get the corresponding sword body. There is a strange power attached to the sword body. After absorbing that power, you can practice the Nine Tribulations and Nine Levels Divine Art according to the formula, and your progress will be very fast!
And the power attached to each sword is different!
If you don't get the Nine Tribulations Sword Body and practice rashly, you will probably die of flames burning your heart within a moment or three!
Secondly, Chu Yang's current physical condition has not yet reached the conditions for practicing the Nine Heavenly Divine Skills. Only after becoming a warrior, with smooth meridians throughout the body, gradually strong Qi and blood, and breaking away from the Small Zhoutian and entering the Great Zhoutian cycle, can one practice the Nine Tribulations and Nine Heavens!
As soon as the east lit up, the sun suddenly jumped out of the horizon. Chu Yang took a deep breath for the last time, stood up, and stood quietly for a while. He felt that his whole body was warm and indescribably comfortable...
He just stood like this, squinting his eyes and looking in the direction of Juyun Peak, where the first section of the Nine Tribulations Sword was quietly buried under the foundation.
Must get it as soon as possible!
Chu Yang's eyes flashed with sharp light. He looked at it for a while before looking back.
He carefully looked around to make sure there was no one else, then he stretched his figure and slowly slid down the steep stone wall. A pair of eyes cautiously looked up, down, left, and right, because if Shi Qianshan was right, then the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae was growing on this stone wall!
Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae is not considered a top elixir. But even if it lasts for three days, it is still something with a price but no market. All big families need this elixir to lay the foundation for their family's future generations!
Many of the descendants of big families were even fed Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae from birth! While the mother's innate Qi has not dissipated, if a top master assists the baby in performing kung fu and converting the medicine into something powerful, he or she can create an earth-shattering martial arts wizard!
If this prodigy can work hard when he grows up, his future achievements will be absolutely unimaginable! And all the achievements, a large part of the credit comes from this golden-blooded Scrophulariaceae when I was young!
The most important reason why the children of the aristocratic family practice so fast and accumulate elixirs one by one!
There is never a shortage of geniuses in this world! Geniuses indeed have many more chances of success than ordinary people! But one thing is equally undeniable: geniuses who die young or slowly become mediocre in this world are always countless times more successful than geniuses!
I am not a genius, but I want to transform myself into a genius who is more genius than a genius! I want the genius in front of me to be nothing!
Chu Yang slid down slowly. His whole body was attached to the slippery cliff, but he could move forward and back freely, like a big gecko, moving steadily on the straight and sharp cliff.
This is a technique he found from a martial master after he killed him in his previous life. It is called "Sky and Sky Divine Movement Technique". If it feels useful, I practice it.
Now that I'm using it, even though my current body has never practiced, I can still use it...
There was a rustling sound below, and a fishy wind suddenly came.
Chu Yang frowned, his eyes flashed, and he exerted force on his right hand that was resting on the stone wall. His whole body moved seven feet across the stone wall silently! With a swipe, a colorful venomous snake passed right by him!
If he hadn't moved sideways just now, the venomous snake's wide mouth would have bitten his leg!
Chu Yang's eyes flashed with joy, there was indeed Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae here! And it’s over a hundred years old!
This snake has colorful scales all over its body, thick arms, and a fleshy crown on its head. It is the colorful golden-crowned snake.
Wild golden-blooded Scrophulariaceae, which are more than a hundred years old, will be guarded by a colorful golden-crowned snake. So when Chu Yang saw this snake, he immediately concluded that the Golden Blood Scrophulariaceae story was true.
This kind of snake has hard scales and is difficult to be damaged by swords.poison. The usual seven-inch weakness of snakes is not a weakness at all on this snake.
The fatal thing about it is the fleshy crown on its head!
Golden-blooded Scrophulariaceae that are more than a hundred years old will emit a faint smell, and this smell is fatally attractive to the colorful golden-crowned snake. This kind of smell can make the colorful golden-crowned snake experience no pain when shedding its skin!
For the colorful golden-crowned snake, golden-blooded scrophulariaceae itself is of little use. But this smell is what it dreams of.
With a rustling sound, the colorful golden-crowned snake quickly turned around and rushed towards Chu Yang. Its tail hit the stone wall with a snapping sound, and it flew up into the air to bite Chu Yang.
Chu Yang's eyes were condensed like needlepoints and he remained motionless. Only when the snake was still one foot away from him did he suddenly dodge, dodge to the right, and jump up, twisting his body into a strange bow shape. The colorful golden-crowned snake passed by him. At this moment, Chu Yang raised two fingers together like swords, concentrated all his strength on his fingers, and stabbed the fleshy crown on the head of the colorful golden-crowned snake!
